title: Failure: bin_column without explicit bin boundaries
description: A bin_column step needs sorted numeric boundaries and optional labels. Queries like 'bucket amounts' are underspecified when they do not provide ranges or label names.
planner_guidance: Ask for bin boundaries and labels when the user asks to bucket or bin values without giving concrete ranges.

example.query: Bucket amount into low medium high
example.problem: The labels are present but numeric boundaries are missing.

rag_note: Do not invent bin boundaries for business data unless the user explicitly provides them.
